PreInvocation.command: top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { printf '{}\n'; exit 0; }; h="$top/.agents/hooks/aida-grant-expiry-notice.sh"; [ -x "$h" ] || { printf '{}\n'; exit 0; }; "$h" --client agy

SessionStart.command: top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { printf '{}\n'; exit 0; }; h="$top/.agents/hooks/aida-mail-notice.sh"; [ -x "$h" ] || { printf '{}\n'; exit 0; }; "$h" --client agy --event SessionStart
